reason: The report's 2.29 estimate comes from an uncontrolled regression, and it is confounded. Training hours correlate strongly with pre-period firm size (0.28) and age (0.17). Adding the 2020 covariates cuts the coefficient to about 0.84 (SE 0.24), so the headline magnitude is overstated by roughly 2.7x. The sign stays positive, but the report ran only one specification, did not adjust for confounders, and its stated effect size is not supported.
